about.title: About
about.metadataDescription: More than 15 years in hardware R&D, spanning RF circuits, system architecture, AI automation, and independent product experiments.
about.introOne: I have more than 15 years of hardware R&D experience, focused on RF circuits and system architecture, with growing work in AI automation and independent product experiments. JK Space is where I document practical engineering work, tools, and technical perspectives.
about.introTwoAfter: turns the comparison of reports from two hardware revisions into a browser-based workflow for report parsing, test-point differences, and DXF coordinate alignment.
about.expertiseHardwareText: From RF and BMS work to system architecture, I turn hardware constraints into practical engineering decisions.
about.expertiseAutomationText: I use n8n, Dify, and agent-based tools to connect data, workflows, and product prototypes.
about.expertiseProductText: I use rapid prototypes to validate needs and explore engineering tools and digital services that can improve over time.
about.methodOne: Clarify engineering constraints first, including report structure, data filtering, and coordinate-system boundaries.
about.methodTwo: Connect the workflow with tools, using AI collaboration and automation to reduce repetition and produce actionable results.
about.methodThree: Validate needs with rapid prototypes grounded in real use cases, then keep refining the tool and product direction.
about.timelineHardwareText: Work centered on RF circuits and system architecture, including engineering decisions across RF, BMS, and hardware systems.
about.timelineAutomationTitle: Expansion into AI and workflow automation
about.timelineAutomationText: Built n8n workflows for data synchronization, notifications, and content processes while exploring Dify and intelligent-agent tools.
about.timelineCurrentTitle: Now · Engineering tools and product experiments
about.timelineCurrentText: Turning needs from hardware work into browser tools and using prototypes to explore product directions.
about.focusText: I focus on AI automation, n8n and Dify workflows, and independent products that solve real problems. From PCB data processing to everyday automation, I care about turning technical experiments into useful tools.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metadataDescription: How JK Space handles site connections, anonymous analytics, language preferences, and files used by the PCB tool.
privacy.intro: JK Space is a personal engineering lab offering project records, technical notes, and browser-based tools. This page explains how the site currently handles data.
privacy.siteTextOne: This site has no member accounts, login, or contact form. It does not collect registration data or store form messages.
privacy.siteTextTwo: If you contact me through an external channel, that platform processes the content you send so we can reply and discuss it. Review the platform’s privacy terms and avoid sending confidential designs or sensitive data.
privacy.hostingTextOne: The site is hosted on Vercel. To provide connections and maintain security, the hosting platform may process necessary connection data such as IP address, browser, device, and request information; logs are handled under its service terms.
privacy.hostingTextTwo: The site uses Vercel Analytics for anonymous page-view statistics. Query parameters and fragments are removed before a page-view event is sent. The site currently sends no custom events and does not include tool-file contents or contact details in analytics events.
privacy.preferenceText: The site does not use advertising pixels or cross-site tracking. Theme preferences may be stored in your browser. When you explicitly switch language, the site writes a jk-locale cookie for one year with SameSite=Lax so later visits retain your choice.
privacy.pcbTitle: Files used by the PCB tool
privacy.pcbTextOne: OrCAD reports, DXF outlines, and test-point data opened by the PCB comparison tool are parsed, compared, and drawn only in your browser. They are not uploaded to the site server or analytics service. Exported results are generated and downloaded by your browser.
privacy.pcbTextTwo: You can try the workflow with the included sample data. Before reporting an issue, remove company, product, and other confidential information from any file you share.
privacy.updatesBeforeLink: If these data practices change, this page and its date will be updated. For privacy questions, visit the
privacy.updatesAfterLink: to see the currently available channels.
